tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_location_final_building_level_map_from_buildings_effect = {
	clear_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id }
		every_key_in_global_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id
			limit = {
				prev = { has_building = prev }
			}
			prev = {
				if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 6 } }
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev value = 6 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 5 } }
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev value = 5 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 4 } }
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev value = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 3 } }
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev value = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 2 } }
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev value = 2 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = prev value >= 1 } }
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = prev value = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_world_final_building_level_maps_from_buildings_effect = {
	every_location_in_the_world = {
		tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_location_final_building_level_map_from_buildings_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_handle_final_building_destroyed_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_location_final_building_level_map_from_buildings_effect = yes
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ownership_site
	owner ?= {
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = 1 }
		tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_site = {
					tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_final_project_for_sacred_mountain_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
			tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_site = {
					NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_sacred_mountain_final_building_trigger = yes }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id value = 1 }
			tv_wonder_ownership_compute_loss_retains_same_wonder_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder } }
				remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_ritual_blessing_modifier
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_country_auto_level_map_effect = yes
	}
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_handle_final_building_destroyed_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_location_final_building_level_map_from_buildings_effect = yes
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ownership_site
	owner ?= {
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = 9 }
		tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_site = {
					tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_final_project_for_palace_of_nations_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
			tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_site = {
					NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_palace_of_nations_final_building_trigger = yes }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id value = 9 }
			tv_wonder_ownership_compute_loss_retains_same_wonder_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder } }
				remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_palace_of_nations_ritual_blessing_modifier
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_country_auto_level_map_effect = yes
	}
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
}

		tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_site = {
					tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_final_project_for_unique_belgrade_fortress_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
			tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_site = {
					NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_belgrade_fortress_final_building_trigger = yes }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id value = 149 }
			tv_wonder_ownership_compute_loss_retains_same_wonder_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder } }
				remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_unique_belgrade_fortress_ceremony_modifier
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable_map = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed target = 149 }
					}
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed key = 149 }
				}
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id
		}

tv_wonder_unique_jingdezhen_imperial_kilns_handle_final_building_destroyed_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_sync_location_final_building_level_map_from_buildings_effect = yes
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ownership_site
	owner ?= {
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = 160 }
		tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_site = {
					tv_wonder_location_is_valid_priority_final_project_for_unique_jingdezhen_imperial_kilns_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
			tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_priority_site = {
					NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_unique_jingdezhen_imperial_kilns_final_building_trigger = yes }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id value = 160 }
			tv_wonder_ownership_compute_loss_retains_same_wonder_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder } }
				remove_country_modifier = tv_wonder_unique_jingdezhen_imperial_kilns_ceremony_modifier
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable_map = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed target = 160 }
					}
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed key = 160 }
				}
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_country_auto_level_map_effect = yes
	}
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_initialize_existing_unique_wonders_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = tv_wonder_existing_unique_wonders_initialized }
		}
		tv_wonder_seed_existing_unique_wonders_effect = yes
		set_global_variable = tv_wonder_existing_unique_wonders_initialized
	}
}

tv_wonder_seed_existing_unique_wonders_effect = {
	location:constantinople = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_hagia_sophia_inaugurated } }
			construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_hagia_sophia_inaugurated cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type }
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type target = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_hagia_sophia_inaugurated } }
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_hagia_sophia_inaugurated }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_hagia_sophia_inaugurated value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_surveyed }
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed target = 102 } }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
				owner ?= {
					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_owner
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = 102 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner }
					scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
						tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
					}
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = 102 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = 102 value = 1 }

		}

				}
			}

				}
			}

					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = 166 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
				}
				if = {

						tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
					}
				}
			}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_great_mosque_of_djenne_inaugurated } }
			construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_great_mosque_of_djenne_inaugurated cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type }
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type target = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_great_mosque_of_djenne_inaugurated } }
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_great_mosque_of_djenne_inaugurated }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_great_mosque_of_djenne_inaugurated value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_surveyed }
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed target = 222 } }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
				owner ?= {
					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_owner
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = 222 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner }
					scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
						tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
					}
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = 222 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = 222 value = 1 }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = 222 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = 222 value = 100 }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence key = 222 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence key = 222 value = 85 }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence key = 222 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence key = 222 value = 85 }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier key = 222 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier key = 222 value = 6 }
		}
	}
	location:benin = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_inaugurated } }
			construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_inaugurated cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
		}

			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type }
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type target = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_inaugurated } }
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_inaugurated }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type key = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_walls_of_benin_inaugurated value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_surveyed }
					NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed target = 223 } }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
				owner ?= {
					save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_owner
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = 223 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner }
					scope:tv_wonder_priority_owner = {
						tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
					}
				}
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = 223 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = 223 value = 1 }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = 223 }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = 223 value = 100 }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence key = 223 }

tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_country_auto_level_map_effect = {
	clear_variable_map = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_auto_cache_country
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type }
			save_scope_as = tv_wonder_auto_cache_location
			every_key_in_variable_map = {
				variable = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_auto_cache_final_building_type value = this }
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_final_building_type }
					}
					scope:tv_wonder_auto_cache_location = {
						set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_auto_cache_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type|local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_final_building_type)" }
					}
					scope:tv_wonder_auto_cache_country = {
						set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_auto_cache_wonder_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id|local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_final_building_type)" }
						if = {
							limit = {
								OR = {
									NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id }
									NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id target = local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_wonder_id } }
								}
							}
							remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_wonder_id }
							add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_wonder_id value = local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_level }
						}
						else = {
							set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_auto_cache_existing_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id|local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_wonder_id)" }
							if = {
								limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_existing_level < local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_level }
								remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_wonder_id }
								add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_auto_level_by_wonder_id key = local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_wonder_id value = local_var:tv_wonder_auto_cache_level }
							}
							remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_auto_cache_existing_level
						}
						remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_auto_cache_wonder_id
					}
					remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_auto_cache_level
				}
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_auto_cache_final_building_type
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_display_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_ritual_completed value = $wonder_ritual_completed$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_ritual_completed value = $wonder_ritual_completed$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_ritual_completed value = $wonder_ritual_completed$ }
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_1_ritual_completed value = $wonder_ritual_completed$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_ritual_completed value = $wonder_ritual_completed$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_level value = $wonder_level$ }

		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_ritual_completed value = $wonder_ritual_completed$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_level value = $wonder_level$ }

		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_ritual_completed value = $wonder_ritual_completed$ }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_overflow_count }
			change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_overflow_count add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_overflow_count value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_location_display_state_effect = yes
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_location_display_location
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_unique_id_to_location
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_unique_id_to_final_building_type
		}
		every_key_in_global_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_unique_id_to_location
			limit = {
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_id_to_final_building_type target = this }
				"global_variable_map(tv_wonder_unique_id_to_location|this)" = { this = scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location }
				"global_variable_map(tv_wonder_unique_id_to_final_building_type|this)" = {
					scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location = {
						NOT = { has_building = prev }
						OR = {
							NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type }
							NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type target = prev } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_has_potential_unique value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id value = prev }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_location_display_building_type
					value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_unique_id_to_final_building_type|local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id)"
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_id value = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_completed value = 0 }
				tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_display_slot_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_location_display_level wonder_ritual_style = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style wonder_ritual_completed = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_completed }
				tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_tooltip_slot_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_location_display_level wonder_ritual_style = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style wonder_ritual_completed = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_completed }
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_building_type
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style
		}
		every_key_in_global_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id
			limit = {
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style target = this }
				scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type target = prev }
				}
			}
			scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location = {
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value = prev }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id|local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type)" }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style|local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type)" }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type|local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type)" }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_completed value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_wonder_location_display_id ?= { this >= 101 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id value = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_completed value = 0 }
					owner ?= {
						if = {
							limit = {
								has_variable_map = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed
								is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_ritual_completed target = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id }
							}
							prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_completed value = 1 } }
						}
					}
					remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 6 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_unique_level ?= { this >= 6 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_unique_level value = 6 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 5 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_unique_level ?= { this >= 5 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_unique_level value = 5 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 4 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_unique_level ?= { this >= 4 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_unique_level value = 4 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 3 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_unique_level ?= { this >= 3 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_unique_level value = 3 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 2 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_unique_level ?= { this >= 2 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_unique_level value = 2 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 1 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_unique_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_unique_level value = 1 }
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 6 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_generic_level ?= { this >= 6 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_generic_level value = 6 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 5 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_generic_level ?= { this >= 5 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_generic_level value = 5 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 4 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_generic_level ?= { this >= 4 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_generic_level value = 4 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 3 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_generic_level ?= { this >= 3 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_generic_level value = 3 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 2 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_generic_level ?= { this >= 2 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_generic_level value = 2 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							var:tv_wonder_location_display_level ?= { this >= 1 }
							NOT = { var:tv_wonder_map_generic_level ?= { this >= 1 } }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_map_generic_level value = 1 }
					}
				}
				tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_display_slot_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_location_display_level wonder_ritual_style = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style wonder_ritual_completed = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_completed }
				tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_tooltip_slot_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_location_display_level wonder_ritual_style = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style wonder_ritual_completed = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_completed }
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_building_type
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_world_location_display_state_effect = {
	every_location_in_the_world = {
		tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	}
}
